heroBody: I build fast, accessible interfaces with AI in the loop from the first sketch to production, and I can take on the backend too.
skillsTitle: What I bring to a team.
skillsBody: Frontend is the core. AI is how I work. The backend is there when the product needs one person to own the whole feature.
frontendBody: Interfaces from design to production: components, motion, responsive layout, accessibility and performance.
backendBody: APIs, data and deployment, so a feature can ship end to end without waiting on another team.
aiBody: AI agents are part of my daily workflow. They make me faster; tests, reviews and verification keep the quality bar.
proofBody: The Soup landing page you are reading: a static multilingual site with a documentation reader and checks that run on every build.
ctaBody: Tell me about the role or the project. Write to me on Telegram.
expBody: Products I have built and teams I work with, from healthcare software to my own app with real users.
epiqBody: Frontend and backend features for a healthcare product, data for a predictive model, and interviews with doctors in hospitals to understand how they work.
nomadBody: Web interfaces with React, TypeScript and Ant Design, connected to backend APIs and application data.
lexiBody: A language-learning app I built and launched on my own, with about 100 users. Frontend, backend, deployment and servers.
judgeBody: A LeetCode-style platform for solving programming problems: a NestJS backend, a React frontend, PostgreSQL storage and code checked through Judge0.
award1: 1st place, AITU / NNEF hackathon: 24 hours on reservoir monitoring and flood prevention.
award2: 3rd place, Datathon 2026: our team trained a YOLO model that detects violations in cash operations from video.
